name: Maela Siroc
seed: To reopen a public well and prove its water belongs to the city.
design: Sand cat, pale gold fur, broad ears, turquoise head wrap and ivory layered traveling coat.
history: A public well examiner from a family of caravan cooks; learned optics to distinguish real water readings from reflected traces.
desire: To reopen a public well and prove its water belongs to the city.
contradiction: Her correct conclusions can become contempt for people afraid of change.
relationships: Kavar owns the disputed equipment; Toma carries archive evidence; Bot helps compare records but needs her local knowledge.
arc: Wins a well through shared evidence, then lets neighbors set use rules she would not have chosen.
story_engine: A mirage appears to prove a witness lied; a rescue costs her the instrument that could win her case.
writer_truth: The well is viable but cannot supply unlimited growth; victory still requires restraint.
